name: Newark Pudding
description: Historical recipe from Common Sense in the Household (1871). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: fine bread-crumbs soaked in a pint of the milk
ingredients.originalText: 1 cup fine bread-crumbs soaked in a pint of the milk

ingredients.name: ½ lb. raisins seeded, cut in two, and dredged with flour
ingredients.originalText: ½ lb. raisins seeded, cut in two, and dredged with flour

instructions.text: Add the soaked bread-crumbs and milk
Put in the rice-flour, wet up first with cold milk
Add the reserved pint of milk, the seasoning, butter, the fruit
Lastly add the whites whipped stiff
Bake an hour in a buttered mould
Turn out and pour sauce over it, serving hard sauce also with it

source.author: Marion Harland
source.originalInstructions:
1. Beat the yolks light
2. Add the soaked bread-crumbs and milk
3. Stir to a smooth batter
4. Put in the rice-flour, wet up first with cold milk
5. Add the reserved pint of milk, the seasoning, butter, the fruit
6. Lastly add the whites whipped stiff
7. Bake an hour in a buttered mould
8. Turn out and pour sauce over it, serving hard sauce also with it
